fact: On 30 September 2023 the ACP reported that the DRC was connected at Moanda to a second submarine cable, 2Africa, beside WACS operating there since July 2013, with Mawezi (Orange and Airtel) to operate the landing station in open-access mode.
title: Fibre-optique: la RDC dotée d'un deuxième câble pour "plus de connexions résilientes" (Expert)
